subject: 올림포스 영어독해 기본1
title: Chapter 1-01: An Apology for an Oversight
fullPassage: By now you've no doubt heard about Chandra's surprise party and are probably wondering why you weren't invited. Chandra certainly was; as soon as she arrived, she asked me, "Where's Christy?" Your absence from the guest list is entirely my fault, and I'm truly sorry for my thoughtlessness. I know how much Chandra values your friendship, and I certainly meant no offense. Even now, I still don't understand how I could have overlooked your name. It's a case, I suppose, of missing the obvious, of not seeing what's right before your eyes. Can you ever forgive me?
